semantic.justification: Original GregorianCalendar is now concrete and implements status/default, locale, adopted zone with explicit/default locale, named const-reference zone constructor overloads, date/date-time, copy, assignment and clone. Constructor dispatch only represents declared C++ overloads; it does not infer a calendar type or parsing rule. Default/locale/zone forms evaluate source UTC getNow and setTime after base initialization even for a failed setter status; numeric date forms evaluate default-zone/default-locale arguments and set source fields without now. Copy construction and clone copy the five derived fields. Assignment clones base ownership and copies only the three cutover fields, retaining destination resolver flags in source write order (CALC-343). The native witness supplies distinct boolean resolver states to distinguish these contracts. Original Julian/Gregorian hybrid arithmetic, signed64 month starts, limits, precedence, checked normalization and cutover shifts remain unchanged. The reference factory is explicit because JS cannot overload pointer ownership by C++ constness; its tag preserves source clone timing in the actual base constructor. Unchanged ICU78.3 library witnesses pass 14994 locale/week cases over 993 requested names and 1440 constructor/copy/weekend cases. They observe all six week/weekend fields, valid/actual Locale values and literal root IDs, incoming error/warning behavior, default and keyword timezone selection, reference/adoption clone counts, null/error and aliased-status clone callbacks, all initialized field/stamp/flag and derived state, date-versus-clock initialization, completed UTC fields and weekend work clones. Existing 63050 scalar/calendar and 12929 time cases also pass after fixtures use real constructors and explicit public controlled baselines. Custom ICU service registration, remaining unconsumed APIs (including general add/roll and custom cutover mutation), full LibreOffice formatter/column/CSV integration, native allocation/OOM/destructor/ABI/undefined or uninitialized memory and platform fake-clock facilities remain uncertified. The actual shared-cache factory and all18 standard calendar classes are now ported separately; their bounded native witnesses do not imply complete ICU/UNO certification. B8TCAE adds portable actual-owner regression evidence from unchanged ICU78.3 compiled witnesses, retaining pinned source/archive/witness SHA256 values in native-observation fixtures. Public constructor/clone/field/time/limit and original protected-hook callers cover all18 calendar owners; actual RuleBasedTimeZone rule graphs include gap/fold enum options; EraRules uses genuine immutable resources; Calendar factory overloads use real cache/locale/timezone owners. Concrete native-derived cache clients verify reference counts, aliases, cached warnings/errors, eviction and destructor order. Only the host Date clock/default locale/timezone are controlled for reproducible native current-era observations; no core method, allocator, service or registry is replaced. This is bounded test evidence, not full native ABI/thread/allocator/whole-module parity. Runtime code and all broad semantic status fields remain unchanged; unresolved100 coverage gaps remain explicit.
